crypto_keylength_justification: The complete supported local-execution configuration uses verified Terraform1.16.5/Go1.26.8 and provider6.13.0/Go1.26.4 with GODEBUG=fips140=on. Actual calibrated module/provider TLS tests reject RSA2047 before HTTP/credentials and accept RSA2048; upstream filters apply to the whole verified chain. HCP uses Local execution so the checked processes perform HTTPS state and provider operations. Optional remote runners require separate qualification. Standard sealed-box encryption uses Curve25519 and 256-bit symmetric primitives; imported HMAC secrets require at least32 random bytes. https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/main/docs/TLS_PROFILE.md
